generate_upb_benchmark_c: generate a C benchmark source file that parses and serializes upb protobuf messages
run_gen_upb_binary_c: run the script with an include header path and message base name to output C code
refactor_RefMessage: refactor the RefMessage function to support additional upb message operations beyond parse and serialize

summarize_gen_upb_binary_c: summarize the script that generates C benchmark code for upb message parsing and serialization
